examples.summary: The Magalu success story. Edit the `body` markdown in the Controls panel — its headings re-feed the outline; drop `share`, `community` and `copyPage` and the left rail goes away. WebKit ships no editorial media, so the banner here is the neutral `@aziontech/webkit/assets/placeholder-image.svg`; pass your own image URLs.
